g.text: token request (dev: password grant, client enterprise-web, PKCE)
claims: sub, roles[], tenant_id, aud (crm-api, erp-api)
policy: crm.read = any of enterprise-admin, crm-admin,
result, or NotFound for another tenant's id
Dev / test alternative (Auth:DevHeaders = true, Development env)
when the X-User-Id header is present.
Off by default; never enable in shared environments.
crm-worker / erp-worker are service accounts (role integration-service, audience limited to their own API).
They carry no tenant_id, so they cannot call tenant-scoped CRM endpoints.
Temporal activities instead receive tenantId in their input and call IntegrationService in-process (no HTTP, no token).
